metadata.title: 90s R&B Group Portrait with Pop-Art Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome studio portrait of three women in 1990s fashion, overlaid with vibrant, multi-colored block lettering in the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subjects against a stark white background
Vibrant primary and secondary color typography contrasting with the grayscale image
Triangular composition of the three figures
Hard-edged shadows cast directly behind the subjects
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for the subjects
High-waisted light wash denim and black bustier tops
Flat, saturated color blocks for the main title lettering
Clean white negative space surrounding the group

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered, waist-up to full-body crop, filling the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored block lettering in the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central face, move to the flanking figures, then drop to the bold colorful text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and sides creates a clean, commercial look.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Monochrome (Black, White, Gray) for the photographic subjects.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure White background to isolate the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange, Magenta, Lime Green, and Cyan for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the desaturated subjects and the fully saturated graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: No color in the photographic layer

letterConstructionRules: Each character assigned a unique solid color
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter is significantly elongated vertically to act as a pillar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large multi-colored display face paired with a smaller, monochromatic condensed secondary face.

preserve: Vertical elongation of the first letter

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the display text.
Clean, modern condensed sans-serif suitable for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of three women in 90s fashion (high-waisted jeans, black bustiers) against a pure white background with hard shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay large, bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the lower center. Color each letter differently (Orange, Magenta, Lime, Cyan). Elongate the first letter vertically. Add a smaller white condensed subtitle to the right.

verificationChecks: Does the first letter of the main title extend lower than the others?
Are the colors in the text solid and highly saturated?
Is the background pure white with visible hard shadows?

adjustableVariables: Amount of vertical elongation on the lead character
mustRedesign: Do not replicate exact facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not have gradients.
Ensure shadows are sharp and dark.
Verify the first letter is significantly taller/longer than the rest.
Confirm the background is blown-out white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Studio Portrait + High-Contrast Hard Shadows + Multi-colored Condensed Sans-Serif Overlay
